rules.name: Cargo.toml present
rules.remediation: Rust crates require Cargo.toml at the package root.

rules.name: Cargo.lock committed for binary crates
rules.remediation: Binary crates should commit Cargo.lock for reproducible builds. Library-only crates (src/lib.rs without src/main.rs) may exclude it.

rules.name: rust-toolchain.toml preferred over plain rust-toolchain
rules.remediation: Use rust-toolchain.toml (TOML) over the legacy plain-text rust-toolchain file.

rules.name: rustfmt.toml present (style consistency)
rules.remediation: Add rustfmt.toml so contributors share formatting rules.
